note: Output-shaft SI units. Continuous effort limits; directional speed guard tapers propulsive effort from 90% to 100% of no-load speed, retains full commanded braking, and never clips physical velocity state. External forces may cause overspeed. The 90% onset is an engineering guard, not a measured torque-speed curve. Wheel armature is zero by user instruction.
